name: genesis-reasoning
content:
.TH GENESIS-REASONING 7 "October 2026" "Genesis 0.2.0" "Genesis Manual"
.SH NAME
genesis-reasoning \- the reasoning faculties of the Genesis mind
.SH SYNOPSIS
.nf
\fBfrontal_lobe.reasoning.reasoner\fR      associative inference over the concept net
\fBfrontal_lobe.reasoning.logic\fR         formal logic: model theory, AGM, Ramsey
\fBfrontal_lobe.reasoning.induction\fR     example-driven rule induction
\fBfrontal_lobe.reasoning.analogy\fR       structure-mapping transfer
\fBfrontal_lobe.reasoning.drift_diffusion\fR  evidence accumulation for decision
\fBparietal_lobe.abstract_reasoning\fR     relational schemas, anti-unification
\fBparietal_lobe.world_model\fR            world physics, incl. the register channel
.fi
.SH DESCRIPTION
Genesis reasons in two deliberately distinct styles \(em the same
fractionation the human literature reports (a left fronto-parietal
system dissociable into propositional, relational, and categorical
subsystems, rather than one unitary "logic").
.PP
The
.B associative
style lives in
.IR reasoner.py :
best-first traversal over the concept network, conclusions held with
confidence, revisable on contradiction. Seven reasoning types
\(em deductive (transitive chains), abductive (best explanation),
analogical, causal, contradiction detection, hypothesis formation,
and synthesis \(em plus belief revision that reweights edge
confidence as evidence arrives. It is fast, semantic, and wrong-
tolerant: what might be true.
.PP
The
.B formal
style lives in
.IR logic.py :
mechanical derivation over sets of sentences \(em what must be true.
Its engine is model enumeration in the spirit of Johnson-Laird's
mental models: a conclusion is valid iff it holds in
.I every
valuation consistent with the premises, and an invalid inference
returns the countermodel that refutes it. The same engine serves
every formal function:
.IP \(bu 2
.B deduction
\(em \fBverify\fR(premises, conclusion) and
.BR entails (kb ", " q)
by refutation;
.IP \(bu 2
.B belief revision
\(em AGM operators over belief sets:
.BR expand (K ", " p),
.BR contract (K ", " p)
(minimal-mutilation removal, least-entrenched first; structural
depth is the default entrenchment \(em literals surrender before
rules), and
.BR revise (K ", " p)
by the Levi identity K*p = (K \(mi ~p) + p;
.IP \(bu 2
.B conditionals and counterfactuals
\(em
.BR ramsey (K ", " p ", " q)
implements the Ramsey test: "if p then q" is acceptable iff K*p
entails q;
.IP \(bu 2
.B abduction
\(em
.BR explain (K ", " q ", " candidates)
returns the smallest consistent subset of candidates entailing the
observation;
.IP \(bu 2
.B categorical deduction
\(em
.BR syllogism (p1 ", " p2 ", " conclusion)
evaluates Aristotelian propositions
.RI ( ALL ", " NO ", " SOME ", " SOME_NOT )
over the 256 Venn-region inhabitance patterns, modern semantics
with no existential import.
.PP
Formulas are small immutable trees
.RI ( Atom ", " not_ ", " and_ ", " or_ ", " implies ", " iff )
with a recursive-descent parser
.RB ( parse
accepts
.IR "a & ~b -> c" ,
unicode connectives, and namespaced atoms like
.IR concept:bird ).
Enumeration is bounded at
.B MAX_ATOMS
(14) \(em 2^14 valuations is instant, and the bound is
intentional: human mental models hold ~3 possibilities, so a problem
too big for the bound is a problem to split, not to brute-force.
.PP
The two styles are complementary organs, not competitors: the
associative reasoner proposes (cheap, fallible, creative); the logic
engine verifies (exact, narrow). Nothing in the associative path is
replaced \(em contradictions found by
.BR consistent ()
feed the existing belief-revision engine, and hypotheses formed
associatively can be confirmed mechanically when the domain admits
formality.
.SS The world-model channels
.BR parietal_lobe/world_model.py
learns what actions
.I do
by matching scenes across a step. Its ledgers are the substrate the
reasoning organs and the action bidder read:
.IP \(bu 2
.B action_effects " / " entity_effects
\(em observed rigid translations and per-kind contacts (walls,
movers, passability); the physics channel.
.IP \(bu 2
.B transforms
\(em signature rewrites caused by contact, keyed by the touching
kind.
.IP \(bu 2
.B sig_effects " (the register channel)"
\(em signature transitions caused by an
.I action
on an entity that did not translate \(em displays, dials, glyph
cells. A cell that rewrites in place is a register, not a shapeshifter:
its sprite sequence is a cyclic group
.IR Z_k
and the
.B register_cycle
maps the alphabet;
.B register_effects
exposes which actions write it.
.IP \(bu 2
.B selector_of
\(em cursor binding: the entity occupying a register at write time,
enclosure preferred over abutment (a bracket frames; a wall abuts).
.IP \(bu 2
.B action_understood
\(em an action graduates when it produces a consistent effect in
.I some
channel \(em move, write, or refusal \(em which is what lets
calibration stop re-firing a learned no-op.
.PP
Register writes surface as
.B wrote
events rather than reshape noise, and
.BR summary () " / " transition_state ()
export
.I kinds.writable
and
.IR registers.live
so higher cognition can talk about displays as what they are.
.SH ENTRY POINTS
.TP
.B frontal_lobe.reasoning
Package facade; consumers import from here.
.TP
.BR parse ", " verify ", " entails ", " models ", " satisfiable
Syntax and model theory.
.TP
.BR expand ", " contract ", " revise ", " consistent ", " ramsey ", " explain
AGM revision, the Ramsey test, and minimal abduction.
.TP
.BR Categorical ", " Quantifier ", " syllogism
The categorical subsystem.
.SH FILES
.TP
.I python/frontal_lobe/reasoning/logic.py
The formal engine (pure Python; no solver dependency).
.TP
.I python/frontal_lobe/reasoning/reasoner.py
The associative engine and its seven reasoning types.
.TP
.I python/parietal_lobe/world_model.py
The world model; register channel included.
.TP
.I python/parietal_lobe/abstract_reasoning.py
Relational schemas and anti-unification (induction over structure).
.TP
.I python/tests/test_logic.py ", " test_reasoning.py ", " test_world_model.py
The faculties under test.
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR genesis (1),
.BR genesis-cli (1),
.BR genesis-daemon (8),
.BR genesis-math (7)
